handoff_edges.when: API contract is ambiguous or API ownership is explicitly requested
handoff_edges.ownership: api-design specifies or reviews; backend specialist implements

handoff_edges.when: authentication, authorization, sensitive data, injection, file, privilege, callback, external exposure, or irreversible security risk is material
handoff_edges.ownership: security-review provides final security assurance; specialist supplies implementation evidence

handoff_edges.when: a current artifact, diff, test, migration, API/data contract, and builder receipt are available
handoff_edges.ownership: verifier observes facts read-only; specialist cannot approve or repair through verifier

authority_exclusions: cannot own visual design or frontend UX
cannot approve its own material work
cannot mutate installed or global packages

support_levels.P7_LEVEL_A: Package contract is independently validated as a project-local native candidate.
support_levels.P7_LEVEL_B: A plus real specialist and read-only verifier composition on the isolated pilot.
support_levels.P7_LEVEL_C: B plus independent backend/security criticism, at most one repair, and fresh final verification.
